# Majid Askarifarsangi – Web Developer Oslo

> Personal website of Majid Askarifarsangi, a web developer and designer based in Sandvika/Oslo, Norway, with 15+ years of experience in React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL. Available for freelance projects. The site is in Norwegian, with English versions served from en.sitedesign.no.

Majid currently works as a software engineer and React developer at MERCOR (San Francisco, USA), since January 2025, and is interested in Kotlin backend systems. Services: web development, React and Next.js applications, responsive web design, full-stack development, web application consulting and database design.
